issues.description: Constructor parameter order for Meal is inconsistent: the problem statement (UML) and the solution expect Meal(String name, String[] ingredients), and the example usage in Main follows that order, but the template's Meal constructor is declared as Meal(String[] ingredients, String name). This mismatch will cause confusion and compilation errors when students follow the example or the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Meal constructor signature to match the specification and solution: public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) { ... }. Alternatively, update the example usages and problem statement to match the template, but aligning the template with the UML and solution is recommended.
